paite: Paul, Pathian sikha leh Jesu Khrist sawitak, Pathian mitelte, aginna uh lamtou ding leh Pathian limsakna toh kithuah thutak theisak ding a sem in;
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

paite: huai tangtawn hinna lametna a kinga, Pathian zuaugen thei lou in khovel om ma a achiam,
english: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

paite: himahleh amah huntak ah thugenna zang in athu ahihlangta, huai thugenna Pathian i Hondampa thupiak bang zel a kepsak ka hi.
english: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,

paite: Ginna kibang a ka tapa diktak Titas kiang ah, Pathian leh Khrist Jesu i Hondampa kiang a kipan hehpihna, zahngaihna leh khamuanna om hen.
english: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

paite: Hiai ziak in ahi huai Kret tuikulh a nang ka hon nutsiat, thilhih zoh nailouhte na hihzoh theihna ding leh thu ka hon piak bang a, khua teng a upate na sehtheihna ding in.
heading: Upate Sehna
english: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

paite: Upa ding zaw gensiatbei, zi khat nei, tate Pathian gingta, nopsak bawl luatna lamsang a gensiat loh lou, dan bang lou a om lou, nei ahih peuhmah uleh,
english: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

paite: saptuam heutu Pathian nasep enkaimi ahih ziak in gensiatbei ahih ding ahi; migenhak, lunggam, uain khamhat, mivuak hat, punna nin a huaihammi hi ding hilou ahi.
english: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

paite: Mi kipahpihdan siam, hoih lam deih, lungsim diktak, midiktat, misiangthou, kidektheimi ahih ding ahi.
english: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

paite: Asinsa thuhilhna dik midang sinsak thei leh selhat mite siam louh tangsak thei ding a sinsak a om thugin muanhuai lenkip mi ahi ding hi.
english: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

paite: Dan bang lou a om, thu mawk gengen leh mikhem chingmi tampi, abik in zeksumte lak a mi a-om uhi.
heading: Sinsakmi Takloute
english: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

paite: Huai mite kam humsak ding ahi, punna nin deih ziak a thuhilh louh ding hilh in, mite a-inkuankuan un apisia uhi.
english: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.

paite: Amaute lak a mi azawlnei khat un houh: "Kret tuikulh a mite zaw zuautheite, gamsa giloute, thadah anhaite ahi uh," achi hi.
english: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

paite: Hiai theihpihna adik ahi. Huaiziak in ginna a adiktheihna ding un leh,
english: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

paite: Judate tangthu phuahtawmte a kisubuai lou ding leh thutak nungngatsan nakte thupiak alimsaklouhna ding un naktak in taihilh in.
english: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

paite: Siangthoute a ding in bangkim asiangthou hi; himahleh minin leh gingloute a ding in bangmah siangthou a-om kei, alungsim uh asia-le-pha theihna uh leng anin hi.
english: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

paite: Pathian thei akichi ua, himahleh athilhih un anawlkhin nak uhi. Kihhuaite, thumangloute, thil hoih sep ding peuhmah a deihlouhte ahi uhi.
english: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
